text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Phew......... With that, the entire 
menu... no.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That wraps up all our plans for the summer 
training camp.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Truly... great job out there, 
Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. ...Good work today to you too, 
Trainer.

The long summer training camp was finally 
over... Morning had arrived, bringing our 
return to the academy.

Chewing deeply on those emotions, I gazed 
at the training camp facility while 
waiting for the return bus.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer!! Excuse me, could you come 
with me, please?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll explain later...! If we don't hurry, 
it's already right—

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, there he is!!" "Trainer!" "Believe's 
Traineeer!!""

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text:
"Is it true that you forced the Umamusume 
through extremely harsh training?!" "We 
heard it involved considerable 
suffering!?"

text_block_list.name: Press Crew
text_block_list.text:
"We hear she's a quiet girl, but have you 
properly confirmed her own intentions?!" 
"Please give us a statement!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, please go through the formal 
procedures before requesting an 
interview~!! ...Trainer, hurry, this way!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that what ended up happening?

Tazuna managed to settle things down for 
the moment, but... it seems there's still 
quite a flood of interview requests.

It looks like things are going to be noisy 
for a while. I gently tell Believe not to 
worry too much about it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, I... didn't mind it all that much to 
begin with... Are you doing okay, Trainer?

In truth, training with a specialized mask 
draws quite a bit of attention. That was 
likely part of what caught their eye.

We've been flooded with interview requests 
from people asking…… 'Aren't you forcing 
the Uma Musume to do the impossible?'

"There will likely be a fair amount of 
critical articles published, regardless of 
how I answer their questions."
choice_data_list:
Still... my convictions haven't changed 
either.

Still... my convictions haven't changed 
either.

text_block_list.text:
I tell her with a smile. I intend to face 
what was written head-on. Because 
receiving criticism is only natural and 
deserved.

Even so, after taking it all in, my 
feelings remain unshakeable.

I've been taught to maintain that kind of 
attitude all along.
choice_data_list:
Because I want to focus on working with 
you.

Because I want to focus on our work 
together.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Understood.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: …………Um, but――

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"An interview. If they don't mind, I'll 
join in as well."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not good at being friendly and 
cheerful. However..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Giving a straightforward answer is 
something I can do, at least.
